sources.prompt: Create a production raster sprite sheet for the Kun desktop bird avatar wardrobe, matching the attached reference's friendly hand-painted game illustration style exactly: organically drawn navy #0e2f66 outline, clean two-tone cel shadows, one small highlight, not vector/3D. Keep rare/common clothes matte; lab-coat and security jacket epic materials subtle.
